case.summary: Case CASE-005 involves two card-not-present transactions (4012170, 4012171) totaling $683.71 on card SC-03005-K949. The real-time model scored transaction 4012170 ($430.53, domestic) at 0.85 risk [EV-7bb34eac]. Transaction 4012170 originated from a new device (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) and an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-8215d9d1, EV-a4f0f4aa]. The card showed 1 prior transaction averaging $253.18 [EV-c8da2d41] and 2 online transactions within 48 hours [EV-f46504e2]. The device profile appears in a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-c7739603], and the customer has a prior fraud case CC-4320 [EV-79340634]. The customer denies authorizing the purchases and confirms physical card possession [EV-90f23ed6]. The pattern matches 6 prior card_not_present_new_device cases [EV-7c9b91bc].

Transaction 4012170 was scored at 0.85 fraud probability by the real-time risk model [EV-7bb34eac]. The transaction originated from a previously unseen device fingerprint (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic environment identifiers) and was routed through an anonymous proxy IP geolocated to Argentina [EV-8215d9d1, EV-a4f0f4aa]. Velocity analysis shows 2 online transactions on this card within a 48-hour window [EV-f46504e2], deviating from the card's historical average of $253.18 per transaction [EV-c8da2d41]. The device fingerprint has been linked to a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-c7739603], and the customer has a previous fraud case CC-4320 on record [EV-79340634]. The customer explicitly denies making the purchases and confirms the physical card remains in their possession [EV-90f23ed6]. This pattern aligns with 6 prior closed cases classified as card_not_present_new_device [EV-7c9b91bc]. The total exposure of $683.71 and the convergence of new-device, proxy, velocity, and customer-denial indicators support the fraud determination.
